Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't.This Digimon's [Your Turn] effect only triggers when your other Digimon digivolve.
Card Q&A.q: I digivolve one of my suspended Digimon into this Digimon. Does this card's [Your Turn] effect let me unsuspend this Digimon itself?

Effect: [When Attacking] You may trash the top card of your security stack to gain 2 memory.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon digivolves, you may unsuspend it.
